title: Re-exports grew from 46.5% to 57.5% of Singapore's merchandise exports
subtitle: Composition of total merchandise exports, % (Singapore dollars, annual sums of monthly data)
source: Source: Singapore Department of Statistics / Enterprise Singapore, table M451001 (Merchandise Trade by Commodity Section), downloaded Nov 12, 2026. Re-exports are goods imported and exported again without substantial transformation; domestic exports are made in Singapore.
